description:
We offer a hybrid work environment. Most US-based positions can also be performed remotely (any exceptions will be noted in the Minimum Qualifications below.)

Our Mission: 

To actively connect people to their next great opportunity.

Who We Are: 

ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

Summary:

We are seeking a Director, Enterprise Product to lead our Enterprise Product team during a high impact phase of growth. In this highly collaborative role, you will partner closely with executive and go-to-market (GTM) leadership to define and deliver the product roadmap for our Enterprise business strategies. You will build and optimize tools that empower our customer-facing teams and create compelling, AI-driven customer-facing experiences. As a "player-coach," you will lead a talented team of Product Managers and Solutions Engineers to drive quantifiable business impact across multiple enterprise subsegments.

Key Focuses:

  • Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with executive and GTM leadership to translate enterprise strategies into actionable product requirements. Reconcile competing priorities across Enterprise subsegments - each with distinct customer types, strategic imperatives, and GTM motions - into a single, well sequenced roadmap.
  • Proactively Identify New Opportunities: Use your knowledge of our existing product portfolio, customer outcome data, and AI capabilities to proactively identify new opportunities to deliver better for Enterprise customers.
  • Navigate Change & Make Smart Trade-offs: Thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift. Know how to cut scope when needed and explain technical trade-offs - like speed versus data accuracy- in plain language to non-technical leaders.
  • Force-Multiply Our Customer-Facing Teams: Build products that automate the work of managing and optimizing recruitment advertising campaigns, so our Sales and Customer Success teams can spend their time on what people do best: building relationships, understanding clients, and growing accounts.
  • Make Our Value Unmistakable to Customers: Build customer-facing experiences, like recommendations, performance insights, and reporting, that clearly show the results ZipRecruiter delivers and build clients’ confidence in and excitement about investing more with us.
  • Coach and Grow the Team: Be a hands-on manager for our Product Managers. Teach your PMs how to dig into root problems, represent customer context, and focus on outcomes.
  • Build High-Functioning Partnerships: Partner seamlessly across Product, Engineering, Decision Science and GTM to establish the right interfaces between functions, clear bottlenecks, and drive outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of product management experience and 3+ years in people manager roles, with a track record of developing talent.
  • Domain Expertise: Experience in AdTech, performance marketing, or an online marketplace. Strong understanding of advertising campaigns and online auctions.
  • Strong Data Fluency: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to seamlessly synthesize quantitative data (e.g., campaign performance metrics) and qualitative data (e.g., customer feedback) to drive prioritization and design decisions.
  • AI Track Record: Demonstrated experience building AI-enabled products that achieved strong customer adoption and quantifiable business impact.
  • Systemic Product Strategy: Proven track record of building compounding products, ensuring individual roadmap milestones serve as deliberate building blocks toward a cohesive, extensible platform rather than disconnected point solutions.
  • Player-Coach Mentality: You are comfortable presenting to the C-suite one hour and diving into prototypes or data dashboards the next.

As part of our team you’ll enjoy:

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance from day one.
  • Financial Security: Competitive salary, annual bonus, and RSU grants for certain roles.
  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible time off, generous parental leave, and internet/home office stipends.
  • Collaboration Weeks: We bring everyone together several times a year for innovation, relationship building, and team fun.
  • Impact: The opportunity to do meaningful work that connects millions of people to their next great career move.

#LI-Remote

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $250,000-$302,500. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations. Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.
